description: Sample DNS resolve client code for Zephyr OS, demonstrating DNS and mDNS resolution with IPv4 and IPv6 support, including DHCP handling.

methods.name: dns_result_cb
methods.description: Callback for handling DNS resolution results, processing IPv4 and IPv6 addresses.

methods.name: mdns_result_cb
methods.description: Callback for handling mDNS resolution results, processing IPv4 and IPv6 addresses.

methods.name: schedule_ipv4_queries
methods.description: Schedules IPv4 DNS and mDNS queries.

methods.name: ipv4_addr_add_handler
methods.description: Handles IPv4 address addition event, triggers DNS queries.

methods.name: check_dhcpv4_addr
methods.description: Checks if DHCP IPv4 address is assigned.

methods.name: setup_dhcpv4
methods.description: Initializes DHCPv4 and sets up event callbacks.
